# Hormozi Lead Magnet — the 7-Step Magnet Engine

Builds a **lead magnet** — "a complete solution to a narrow problem" — so good that strangers happily
trade their contact info for it, consume it, and then want the **core offer** that solves the *next*
problem it reveals. A Grand Slam Offer works for free stuff too, so make it a no-brainer.

**Method (authority):** `../_hormozi-shared/references/lead-magnet-7-step.md`. Read it before building
and run the 7 steps in order — never skip or reorder. Also read `decision-and-fidelity-rubric.md` and
`value-equation.md` (the magnet is judged on the same 4 value drivers).

## When to use
- "Build my lead magnet", "what free thing do I give away", "make a freebie that converts", or as
  step 2 of the `hormozi-leads` chain (after the roadmap, before the channels).

**Use a sibling instead when:** the ask is *how to distribute* the magnet — that's a Core Four channel:
`hormozi-lead-warm`, `-content`, `-cold`, or `-paid`. Building the paid **offer** the magnet points to
is `hormozi-offers`. Picking *which channel to start with* is `hormozi-lead-roadmap`.

## Inputs
- The **core offer** + **avatar** it serves (a magnet is built *for* an offer — run `hormozi-offers`
  first if none exists).
- The customer's problem sequence and the offer's shape (worse-with-time / recurring / complex).
- Rough delivery economics — or mark `<placeholder>` values. If offer or avatar is missing, ask first.

## Procedure
1. **Problem + who** — via the Problem-Solution cycle, pick a problem that is **narrow *and*
   meaningful**, and confirm the *next* problem it reveals is one your **core offer solves for money**.
2. **How to solve it — pick the magnet TYPE:** *Reveal Their Problem* (diagnosis; best when it worsens
   with delay) · *Samples and Trials* (brief full access; best for recurring solutions) · *One Step of
   a Multi-Step Process* (best for complex offers). Match the type to the offer's shape.
3. **How to deliver it — pick the FORMAT:** Software (a tool) · Information (teach) · Services (do it
   free) · Physical. 3 types × 4 formats = up to 12 magnets; sketch 2–3 versions and rotate them.
4. **Test what to name it** — test **Headline → Image → Subheadline**, in that order (headline first;
   ~5× more people read it). Test cheaply with polls / "reply 1 or 2" / DMs. Vote **and** "when can I
   get it?" = winner.
5. **Make it easy to consume** — package in every format you can (phone + desktop; video/text/audio);
   easing consumption alone can 2×–4× take *and* consumption.
6. **Make it darn good** — **"Give Away The Secrets, Sell The Implementation."** Deliver more value than
   the core offer's price *before* they buy; 99% won't buy but all judge your reputation on the free.
7. **CTA to the offer** — a clear **what-to-do** ("book the call", "reply") + a **reason-why now**
   (real scarcity / urgency / any-reason-after-"because"). "Don't be clever, be clear." Do it often.

Then advertise the magnet through the Core Four — `hormozi-lead-warm` / `-content` / `-cold` / `-paid`,
picked by `hormozi-lead-roadmap`.

## Output contract
Per the rubric header, produce, for this product: the **narrow problem + avatar** (and the next problem
the core offer sells against); the **magnet type** with why it fits the offer's shape; the **delivery
format** with 2–3 rotate-able versions; a **name-test plan** (2–3 headline candidates, image +
subheadline candidates, ordered, with the poll/ask method); the **consumption + quality plan** (formats
shipped, how it over-delivers vs. the offer price); and the **CTA** (what-to-do + a reason-why) in the
product's voice. Every value/price figure is real economics or `<placeholder>` — never fabricated.

## What we are intentionally NOT doing
- Not building the core offer (that's `hormozi-offers`) — we require one to point at.
- Not running the advertising channels (that's the Core Four sub-skills) — this produces the magnet.
- Not fabricating value/cost math — derive from real economics or mark placeholders.

## Sources and basis
*$100M Leads* — lead vs. lead magnet + salty pretzels (l.641–649); the 7 steps: Problem-Solution cycle
(l.669–685), three magnet types (l.687–721), four delivery formats + 12-magnet grid (l.723–747), name
testing (l.749–801), ease of consumption (l.803–817), give-secrets-sell-implementation (l.819–833), CTA
+ reason-why (l.835–877); the four things a good magnet does (l.909–919). Encoded in
`../_hormozi-shared/references/lead-magnet-7-step.md`.
